name: Sprinkler
summary: An Off, Auto and On switch that pops a garden sprinkler out of the lawn and sweeps a real water jet
about: A three-way toggle for a back lawn sprinkler, drawn as a sunny garden that turns to a moonlit one in dark mode. The knob squashes and springs between Off, Auto and On; watering shakes the ground, pops the head up with a spray of dirt and sweeps a jet of water drops that arc, splash and leave a rainbow. A soil probe and meter track the moisture, so the grass greens and the flowers lift their heads, and Auto waters by itself below 35% and stops at 70%.
how: Pick Off, Auto or On on the switch (click, or Tab to it and use the arrow keys).
On waters straight away: the head pops out of the lawn and sweeps its jet across the grass.
Auto watches the soil meter, starts below 35% and stops at 70% by itself.
Press Water now for a 6 second burst in Off or Auto; press it again to stop early.
Switch to Off to stop the water and let the head sink back into the ground.
